inputs: kline: close (per swept stock, all markets)

lineage.note: beta vs 等权市场代理 (声明代理——快照无指数 kline); BAB 偏好低 beta, 分位翻转 (低 beta 高分位)

limits: DECLARED sweep cost: reads every swept stock's kline once per scan
DECLARED proxy: market portfolio = equal-weight mean daily return of swept same-market stocks (inner-joined dates, >=60-return members)
DECLARED poison-member guard: dates covered by <90% of members dropped, then gappy members dropped — one sparse/odd-window kline (e.g. 320 bars over 7 years) cannot collapse the strict inner join
rows without kline or <10 common observations -> NaN + data_gap
percentiles within-market only, ascending=False (low beta -> high pctl)
